scope: M416 balanced selected-slice prelayout standard-cell averaged power and energy per measured cycle at TT 0.9 V, 25 C, 3.0 ns ideal clock, ZeroWireload, no SPEF, zero macro, using the frozen M438 direct mapped-gate SAIF; excludes reset signoff, CTS, SRAM/macro, extracted interconnect, full Conv, full network, system energy/speedup, paper-PPA-ready, and headline claims
verified: R1 and R2 have explicit FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE_DO_NOT_CITE markers with outer exit codes 22 and 25. R1 contains 4,139 out-of-range ramps; R2's invalid source-echo audit expected three update_power source lines but observed one.
R3's RUN_MANIFEST.sha256 is exactly one stdin '-' entry hashing empty input, so its seal is vacuous and R3 remains FAILED_INVALID_VACUOUS_SEAL_DO_NOT_CITE. No obsolete numeric power was used.

R4 has 44 relative './' manifest entries, zero stdin targets, zero duplicate targets, zero work-subtree targets, zero hash mismatches, and all required targets. Both the manifest and its outer seal self-check from the R4 cwd returned rc=0.
A complete 47-file R4 tree snapshot was identical before and after the independent hammer; the R4 run was not modified.
PrimeTime returned rc=0. The runtime ledger is the exact ordered nine-line sequence for check_power, update_power, and report_power at 100 ps, 50 ps, and 200 ps.
All three check_power reports succeeded with zero Warning, out-of-range ramp, missing-table, or missing-function findings.
The three raw power reports uniquely declare mW and uniquely contain internal, net-switching, leakage, and total fields. Every field was reparsed without using the R4 receipt.

Raw SAIF parsing independently found 22,800 entries, 21,827 with nonzero toggle count, zero nonzero-TX entries, zero total TX duration, and 6,288,008.5 ns duration. PrimeTime reports independently show 22,800/22,800 annotated nets and 20,803/20,803 fully annotated leaf cells.
The exact nonzero-toggle coverage is 21,827/22,800 = 95.73245614035088 percent.
The 100 ps total energy recomputes as 6.25380802 mW times 6,288,008.5 ns divided by 2,096,003 measured cycles = 18.76142256815862 pJ per measured cycle.
The largest absolute total-power change across 50/100/200 ps relative to the 100 ps primary point is 0.0070833642251688644 percent.

Raw reports and engine text confirm TT 0.9 V, 25 C, a 3.0 ns ideal clock, ZeroWireload, no SPEF, and no propagated clock. The power table reports zero memory group power and the scope freezes macro count at zero.
The clock_network group is 4.58843946 mW and carries PrimeTime's 'i' attribute, meaning it includes register clock-pin internal power. It does not contain CTS buffers or extracted clock interconnect.

findings.title: Reset timing is deliberately outside signoff
findings.detail: check_timing reports exactly one primary input without a clock-relative input delay: reset_n. The mapped SDC false-paths reset_n, while the power flow merely applies 100 ps input slew and the measured SAIF holds reset_n static high. This is sufficient for the admitted averaged-power run but cannot support recovery/removal, minimum-pulse, asynchronous-reset, or reset-signoff claims.

findings.title: PrimeTime emitted two SDC 2.1 versus requested 2.2 warnings
findings.detail: The mapped SDC declares version 2.1 and read_sdc requests 2.2, producing two SDC-2 warnings that some constraints or options may not function. No Error/Fatal, negative max path, or observed power-gate failure resulted, so the narrow power admission survives. Align the SDC version and rerun before calling the design paper-PPA-ready or timing-signoff complete.

findings.title: clock_network is ideal-clock register-pin power, not CTS power
findings.detail: The 4.58843946 mW clock_network group is 73.37 percent of the 100 ps total and has the 'including register clock pin internal power' attribute. With ideal clock, no CTS, ZeroWireload, and no SPEF, it excludes clock-tree buffers and extracted distribution capacitance. It may remain inside the prelayout selected-slice total but must not be labeled post-CTS clock power.

allowed_claim: For the M416 balanced selected slice under TT 0.9 V/25 C, 3.0 ns ideal-clock, ZeroWireload prelayout standard-cell assumptions and the frozen mapped-gate SAIF, the 100 ps primary input-slew point is 6.25380802 mW or 18.761422568 pJ per measured cycle; 50/200 ps total-power sensitivity is at most 0.0070833642 percent.
forbidden_claims: R4 is SRAM-, macro-, interconnect-, CTS-, full-Conv-, full-network-, or system-energy complete.
The 4.58843946 mW clock_network value is post-CTS clock-tree power.
The 100 ps reset_n input slew is reset timing signoff.
R4 is paper PPA ready or a DATE headline result.
